ROW.COLUMN: (ML/CU) High Risk Transactions: High Risk Counter Party

Financial institutions apply enhanced scrutiny to transactions involving geographies and entities (including other financial institutions) that are considered as high risk. Transactions involving high-risk geographies and entities generate increased exposure to money laundering and other types of fraud. Mantas utilizes external and internal watch lists (provided by the client) to identify high-risk geographies and entities. For examples, FATF-designated countries; INCSR-designated major Money Laundering countries; entities or sanctioned countries appearing on OFAC lists; internal lists that the institution maintains. This scenario generates alerts on firm accounts, customers, household, correspondent banks, and external entities engaging in high risk transactions based on the risk of the counter parties, geographies, and products involved in the transactions.
